{{Quote|&hellip;And the ''stars''! The ''stars'' are all wrong! I'm a ''navigator'', and those two constellations haven't been in ''that'' configuration for&hellip; for&hellip; eight thousand years. Oh, no.|The stormtrooper navigator|<ref name="Tilotny" />}}
A '''navigator''' served as part of a unit of three [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the unit pursued [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Bedlam/Legends|Bedlam]], where the stormtroopers proceeded to chase her on [[Limb/Legends|foot]]. Both Organa and the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], however, then encountered the omnipotent transdimensional [[Bedlam Spirits|entities]] [[Tilotny]], [[Horliss-Horliss]], and [[Cold Danda Sine]], who at the [[Time/Legends|time]] were experimenting with affecting the physical reality.

Tilotny transformed one of the stormtroopers into [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]] and later merged the two others into a single short-lived being. Subsequently the entity [[Splendid Ap]] was tasked with reversing those changes; however, since Splendid Ap had a limited understanding of the concepts of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and time, he ended up [[Time travel/Legends|transporting]] the revived stormtroopers [[8000 BBY|eight thousand years]] into the past. The [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] then noticed that fact by observing the relative configuration of a pair of [[Constellation/Legends|constellations]] in Bedlam's [[Atmosphere/Legends|sky]].

==Biography==
===A fatal encounter===
{{Dialogue|Horliss-Horliss|Did you style ''those'' as well, Tilotny?|Cold Danda Sine|Tilotny has ''repeated'' a ''shape''. Dull, ''talentless'' Tilotny!|Tilotny|It&hellip;it was an ''oversight''. Tilotny was distracted by your ''rudeness''!|attr=Horliss-Horliss, Cold Danda Sine, and Tilotny notice the three stormtroopers|src=<ref name="Tilotny" />}}
A [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] at one point served as a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Tilotny" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="0 ABY">{{StoryCite|story=Tilotny Throws a Shape|book=The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 154}} is set between {{Film|IV}} and [[Star Wars (1977) 35|''Star Wars'' (1977) 35]], wth the events of the latter taking place before the [[Evacuation of Yavin 4]]. Per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', "Tilotny Throws a Shape" must therefore be set in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> they were a part of a [[Three stormtroopers|unit]] of three stormtroopers that
[[Mission to Bedlam|pursued]]<ref name="Tilotny" /> [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> to<ref name="Tilotny" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Bedlam/Legends|Bedlam]].<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> Forcing Organa to land her [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the stormtroopers also set down their own vessel and pursued their quarry on [[Limb/Legends|foot]]. While fleeing across Bedlam's rock-and-dust-covered plains, Organa tripped over what turned out to be, to her bewilderment, a [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper helmet]] whose pitted and corroded appearance suggested it had been lying there for [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]].<ref name="Tilotny" />

[[File:OrganaBedlamSpirits-TilotnyThrowsAShape.jpg|thumb|left|300px|An encounter with (center; left-to-right) Cold Danda Sine, Tilotny, and Horliss-Horliss proved fatal to the stormtrooper navigator and their unit.]]
The three stormtroopers eventually caught up with the princess. Like her, however, they paused at the sight of three<ref name="Tilotny" /> omnipotent, transdimensional,<ref name="TEA" /> and abstract [[Bedlam Spirits|entities]]<ref name="CSWE Tilotny">{{CSWECite|III|248|Tilotny}}</ref>&mdash;[[Tilotny]], [[Horliss-Horliss]], and [[Cold Danda Sine]]&mdash;discussing the physical shapes that they had recently manifested for themselves as well as those of Organa and the stormtroopers. Tilotny, who was claiming to have been responsible for forming everything in the [[Universe/Legends|physical world]], felt ashamed by Cold Danda Sine's assumption that she had unoriginally "repeated" Organa's form in creating the stormtroopers.<ref name="Tilotny" />

To prove her inventiveness, Tilotny then transformed one of the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] into an effigy made of [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]]. After Horliss-Horliss subsequently turned Organa's [[Heart/Legends|heart]] into diamond&mdash;a feat that was seen by Tilotny as much more "subtle" than hers&mdash;Tilotny turned her attention back toward the two remaining stormtroopers, who were beginning to discreetly back away. Tilotny transmuted the two [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] into a single being with partially merged limbs&mdash;to a near-immediate [[Death/Legends|lethal]] outcome.<ref name="Tilotny" />

===Cleanup===
{{Quote|We're in the ''past''. ''Thousands of years'' in the past! By the time our own century rolls round we'll be nothing but&hellip; bones.|The navigator's fellow stormtrooper|<ref name="Tilotny" />}}
At that point, Cold Danda Sine remarked that the fact that neither of the four beings they had encountered were "moving" anymore was a sign of Tilotny's "tastelessness," after which they and Horliss-Horliss, having become bored with the formation of shapes, prepared to depart. A fourth entity, [[Splendid Ap]], was tasked with correcting the "disorder" that Tilotny had caused, which involved reviving Organa and the stormtroopers and returning them to their original state.<ref name="Tilotny" />

[[File:TheresASplendidApForThat.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Splendid Ap revived Leia Organa and the three stormtroopers and transported the latter into the past.]]
Having a limited understanding of the concepts of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and [[Time/Legends|time]], however, Splendid Ap [[Time travel/Legends|transported]] the stormtroopers [[8000 BBY|eight thousand years]] into the past. When the troopers regained consciousness, they noticed the undisturbed ground at the site they had previously landed their starship. The stormtrooper who was a navigator then also noticed a pair of [[Constellation/Legends|constellations]] in Bedlam's [[Atmosphere/Legends|sky]] that, by their time, had not been in such a configuration for eight millennia, leading the unit to realize they had been sent back in time. Meanwhile, Organa came to near the [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletal]] remains of a stormtrooper.<ref name="Tilotny" />

==Skills and abilities==
The stormtrooper was knowledgeable enough in astronomy to notice that the relative position of two constellations in the sky of the world Bedlam had last been observable eight thousand years prior.<ref name="Tilotny" />

==Equipment==
The stormtrooper navigator donned stormtrooper [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and wielded a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. Along with the rest of their unit, they used a starship that could be landed on a planetary surface.<ref name="Tilotny" />

==Behind the scenes==
The stormtrooper navigator first appeared in "[[Tilotny Throws a Shape]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story written by [[Alan Moore]], penciled by [[John Stokes]], and published in the [[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 154|154th issue]] of [[Marvel Comics]]' ''[[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly]]'' comic-book series in [[February]] [[1982]].<ref name="Tilotny" />
